_comment: Manual coordinate overrides for the 2400-tall Expanded Adventure world. MapCoord() checks this table FIRST (by legacy tile coord); if a legacy (x,y) is not listed, it falls back to the piecewise formula: newY = oldY + (oldY >= 1791 ? 400 : 200), X unchanged. Coords are in TILE space. 'type': "fix" = correction where the formula guesses wrong; "move" = intentional authored relocation on the expanded map only. Only legacy (2000-space) content is looked up here — content gated ExpandedAdventureCondition is authored natively in 2400-space and bypasses MapCoord entirely.

overrides.note: "Lost Oolacile Forest" location soapstone. Formula alone would put it at 5422,1125; it was relocated on the expanded map only. Legacy adventure + remix keep it at its own 5422,925.

"Three stone pillars... enchanted with magic and impervious..." soapstone. Sits at old-Y 1778 (below the 1791 fold) but was dragged with the underworld, so it got +400 not +200. The single verified exception to the formula across all 482 signs.
"To the EAST--> The Rainforest of the Orid Tribe..." soapstone. Formula alone would put it at 5338,1067; relocated on the expanded map only. Legacy adventure + remix keep it at its own 5338,867.
"Unadin Inn" soapstone. Formula alone would put it at 5257,1065; relocated on the expanded map only. Legacy adventure + remix keep it at its own 5257,865.
